title: Blog Posts for 2025 (Dynamics 365 Lab)
summary: Year-end index of the author's Business Central blog posts from 2025, grouped into general feature and solution articles, 2025 wave 1 (BC26) posts and 2025 wave 2 (BC27) posts. Topics include Copilot and agents, AL coding techniques, administration, SharePoint and Dataverse integration, reporting and Excel features.
key_points: Lists the author's 2025 Business Central posts, each with its publish date
General section covers AL how-tos, customizations, admin tips and some BC25 minor update features
Separate sections collect posts on BC26 and BC27 release wave features
Recurring themes are Copilot and agents, SharePoint and Graph API, report layouts and Power Automate
